text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? No way...
My skin's breaking out...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Diet...? Lack of sleep...?
Maybe my skincare wasn't enough...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
No matter how hard I try, I can't keep my rough skin under control...
It's just like my rivals, osu.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: "Anyway, it's my own inadequacy that caused this. I have to do something about it...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Win Variation tried researching remedies and solving it on her own.
However, her skin irritation didn't improve in the slightest.
